title: C Major Chord Essentials: Fretting, Muting, and Relaxed Technique (JustinGuitar)
summary: This video educates beginning guitarists on forming the C major chord with an emphasis on accurate finger placement, muting the low string, and maintaining a relaxed fretting posture. The instructor walks through the proper fretting order (index on the 2nd string 1st fret, middle on the 4th string 2nd fret, ring on the 5th string 3rd fret), then addresses common challenges such as muting the thickest string, avoiding string buzz, and ensuring the 4th string rings clearly. Additional guidance covers finger-angle, the tip-focused contact of the fretting fingers, minimal hand gap, and the importance of a relaxed arm and shoulder to accommodate individual hand shapes. The video also outlines a practical approach to practicing chord changes (e.g., maintaining a hand-off and re-landing the fingers) and foreshadows future transitions to chords like G and D.
